phase-1.title: Basic Engineering & Feasibility
phase-1.what: Turns a lab result, process idea or upgrade need into a defined engineering basis and a Class 4 budgetary estimate, before you commit to detailed design or hardware.
phase-1.best_when: The process works at lab scale or the requirement is still forming, and you need a budget basis or a go/no-go for the next investment decision.
deliverables: Preliminary PFD and heat & mass balance, where process data allows
Preliminary equipment list and utility requirements

phase-2.title: Detailed Engineering
phase-2.what: Develops the agreed basis into a coordinated, procurement-ready engineering package, priced to a Class 2 estimate.
phase-2.best_when: The process basis is settled and you need a buildable package: for your own fabrication, for a tender, or for a build phase with us.
deliverables: Skid layout, general arrangement and 3D coordination
Piping and mechanical drawings within the agreed scope
FAT/SAT plan and acceptance criteria, agreed before hardware is bought
Class 2 cost estimate (AACE) and agreed decision package

phase-3.title: Integrated Design & Build
phase-3.what: One accountable team engineers, procures, fabricates, supplies instrumentation and electrical works, programs, integrates and tests the contracted system, followed by defined site support and handover.
phase-3.best_when: You want one partner responsible from drawings to a working system.
deliverables: Procurement, expediting and vendor document review
Data architecture, with optional PlantON™ connection
FAT, with scope agreed per project
Installation supervision, SAT and commissioning support
As-built drawings, O&M manuals, spare parts list and handover

planton-deploy.title: PlantON deployment
planton-deploy.what: Commission the data before scaling the dashboard. Results are measured against a baseline agreed up front: reporting hours, utility intensity, downtime or rejection.
deliverables: Define: The decision, users, reports and success measure.
Review sources: PLC, SCADA, meters, databases and IT/OT constraints.
Map and validate: Selected data with units, timestamps and context.
Build and verify: Reports, dashboards and alerts tested against source data.
Commission: Stabilize through the first reporting cycles.
Expand: More lines or use cases once the first layer is trusted.

auto-modernize.title: Modernize without stopping the plant
auto-modernize.what: Keep the equipment that still works. Replace the fragile control layer in stages you can test and roll back.
deliverables: Assess: Installed PLCs, HMIs, panels, networks, field devices and documentation, with backups and baseline records captured first.
Define the migration strategy: Keep, migrate, replace or isolate, with a technical reason for each.
Plan the implementation: Phased cutovers, temporary interfaces, testing requirements and rollback paths around production.
Simulate, test and validate: Simulation, functional testing and FAT on the high-risk changes before anyone goes to site.
Commission and hand over: Implement the approved change, verify operation and update drawings, backups and system documentation.

auto-services.title: Our industrial automation capabilities
auto-services.what: Take one work package, or combine them into a single integrated scope.
deliverables: Brownfield modernization & migration: Upgrade PLCs, HMIs, SCADA, panels and networks in planned, testable stages around your production window.
New control systems: Control philosophy, PLC/PAC logic, HMI/SCADA, alarms, trends and historian for new lines, skids and plants.
Batch & recipe control: S88 (ISA-88) structure with reusable phases, configurable recipes, guided manual additions, batch reports and audit trails.
Electrical & instrumentation design: Instrument selection, I/O and load definition, electrical design and control panels with UL 508A, CSA or CE approval.
Multi-vendor integration: OEM machines, skids, drives, remote I/O and legacy controllers under one control and operator view; DCS links over OPC UA.
FAT, SAT, commissioning & support: Simulated FAT, loop checks, controlled start-up, backups, as-builts, training and change management after handover.
